module.purpose: Implements server-side (Fizz) thenable tracking and Suspense suspension for React SSR, mirroring fiber/flight thenable modules.
module.summary: This module provides the mechanism for React's server renderer to track promises (thenables) used during rendering and to suspend the render by throwing a special opaque exception. It maintains a per-component ThenableState array, supports reading previously resolved values, and exposes dev-only helpers to capture the component stack and debug task at the point of suspension. The code is intentionally symmetric with ReactFiberThenable and ReactFlightThenable.
module.businessContext: Critical for React Suspense SSR streaming. If broken, server renders hang, throw incorrectly, or leak internals to userspace.

detail.signature: export function trackUsedThenable<T>(thenableState: ThenableState, thenable: Thenable<T>, index: number): T
preconditions: thenableState is an array-like object (ThenableState) that may hold previous thenables per index
thenable is a Thenable (has a then method) and may have a status expando property
postconditions: If thenable.status === 'rejected', throws thenable.reason or a generic Error if reason missing
If thenable is pending, instruments it (sets status='pending' and attaches handlers) and throws SuspenseException
If previous entry at index is undefined, thenable is appended to thenableState
If previous entry exists and differs, previous is reused and new thenable's rejection is silently observed via noop

Pending thenables are mutated to have status/value/reason expandos when settled

thenable.status === 'rejected' && reason === undefined && !('reason' in thenable): throws Error with specific message

thenable.status undefined: instrumented with pending and handlers attached
thenable resolves synchronously after attach: status re-checked and value returned or reason thrown instead of suspense
stateMutations: thenableState[index] or thenableState.push(thenable) when index === length
thenable.status, thenable.value, thenable.reason assigned by attached handlers when settled

units.name: ensureSuspendableThenableStateDEV

detail.name: ensureSuspendableThenableStateDEV
preconditions: Must be called in a __DEV__ environment.
thenableState must be a non-empty array of Thenable objects.
The last element of thenableState must have a status of either 'fulfilled' or 'rejected'.
postconditions: The last thenable in thenableState has its status, value/reason, and then method reset to a pending-like state.
The last thenable's .then method is replaced with a noop to prevent crashes from corrupted state.
A restore function is returned that reinstates the original status, value/reason, and .then method of the thenable.
invariants: The function only executes its body when __DEV__ is true.
The returned restore function must be called exactly once to reinstate the thenable's state.
edgeCases: If thenableState is empty, thenableState[thenableState.length - 1] would be undefined and the function would throw a TypeError when accessing .status.
If the last thenable's status is neither 'fulfilled' nor 'rejected', no case matches and the function falls through without returning a restore function.

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: If thenableState is empty or the last thenable is not resolved, a TypeError or undefined behavior occurs.

stateMutations: Mutates the last thenable object in thenableState by deleting its value/reason and status properties, and replacing its .then method with noop.
detail.summary: DEV-only helper that temporarily resets the last thenable in a thenableState back to pending so it can be re-suspended, returning a restore function to reinstate its original resolved state.
